L11: This lesson uses the 2011 amounts. The 2022 forms raise them: money $300; securities, watercraft, trailers and theft of jewelry $2,000; theft of firearms and of silverware $3,000; business property at home $3,000; the other-residence and self-storage floor $1,500; tree removal $3,000 per loss and $1,500 per tree; trees, shrubs and plants $1,500 each. Learn both sets.
L12: This lesson uses the 2011 amounts. In the 2022 forms the small-loss test for replacement cost before repairs is under 5% of the insurance and under $5,000, not $2,500.
L13: This lesson uses the 2011 amounts and names. In the 2022 forms, damage to property of others pays up to $5,000 and loss assessment $2,000; the business pay threshold is $5,000; and the endorsements are titled Supplemental Watercraft Liability Coverage, Designated Business Pursuits Liability Coverage and Limited Home Day Care Coverage.
L18: This lesson gives Protective Safeguards as its example of an interline endorsement. That was true of the 1998 form (IL 04 15). ISO's current Protective Safeguards form, CP 04 11, applies to commercial property only. What an interline endorsement is has not changed: it modifies more than one coverage part.
